items.egg_id: E-09 念旧之人 (19-r2: 整关零出售通关 → 系统'你一座塔都舍不得卖'; collection keepsake 'all the cities you built')
items.review: 3/3 frames PASS @2s/6s/10.5s — lateral pan traverses era strata in order (wood+stone → stone+iron+radar edge → radar+spire with earlier ghosts retained); palette follows hex anchors; no text
items.prompt: Slow lateral tracking shot gliding right across a monumental commemorative collage scroll: one single ancient defense line rendered as overlapping silhouettes from successive eras, stacked like translucent geological strata on the same rampart. Frontmost, a three-tier wooden watchtower with thatched eaves in dawn ochre-gold (#C9915C); behind it a stone bastion with gables and crenellations in bronze verdigris (#4E8A6E); behind that a riveted iron lattice truss tower in riveted-iron ochre red (#A8503C); then a concrete radar tower with a parabolic dish in electric grid blue (#3D7EA6); deepest, a flowing nano energy spire with floating rings in fusion cyan (#3FC1C9). Each older silhouette remains visible as a ghost layer beneath the newer ones, era colors accumulating into rich sediment. Glowing memory-fragment particles drift over the scroll like keepsake dust. Layered color strata, sedimentary composition, nostalgic keepsake-album mood, gentle ambient sound. No text, no letters.

items.egg_id: E-05 零的观察手记 (19-r2: 战报回放尾页系统私货日志; Q17C both-approved)
items.review: 3/3 frames PASS @2s/4s/6.5s — cold cyan holographic UI progressively overgrown by naive warm crayon doodles (tower/stars/spirals/arrows/sun), contrast ratio evolves per brief; zero readable or pseudo-writing marks; no artifacts
items.prompt: Close-up of a cold holographic system interface floating in a dark void: translucent fusion-cyan (#3FC1C9) panels, fine grid lines, slow scanning beams, hexagonal lattice nodes and abstract glowing data blocks. Across this sterile machinery, childlike naive crayon doodles gradually grow in warm hand-drawn strokes of ochre-gold (#C9915C) and ember orange (#E07B39): a wobbly little watchtower, crooked stars, a spiral scribble, looping arrows, a lopsided sun. The clumsy warm doodles spread along the panel seams, circling and playfully redrawing the cold UI elements, as if a hidden intelligence were secretly learning to draw by watching. The contrast deepens until the page feels like the observation journal of a child overlaying a machine. Soft holographic glow meets waxy crayon texture. No text, no letters, no numbers, no readable characters — only abstract doodle shapes.

In deep-space dark matter violet-black (#1D1B33), a colossal stargate ring glows in deep stargate indigo (#3E55C9), seen from behind the small dark silhouette of a lone watcher who stands perfectly still, back to camera, at the bottom of the frame. A hairline fissure of pale zero-point cyan (#BFE8F2) light runs down the heart of the gate and slowly widens by a mere sliver; gravitational lens arcs bend faintly around the crack, and drifting memory-light dust rises. Deep inside the fissure something almost imperceptible glimmers — never fully revealed. The watcher never moves. Layered nebula strata, extreme restraint, quiet dread and wonder, low ambient drone. No text, no letters.
